question.text: Under SEBI PM Regs, FEES may include all EXCEPT:

answer.text: Exit load within first 3 years per SEBI schedule

explanation.text: The Logic: UPFRONT fees are PROHIBITED under PM Regs 2020 — no 'set-up' fee or commission-like charge allowed. The Trap: Management/performance/exit/op-expenses are allowed; upfront is banned. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10 covers; XXI-B applies. Manager's Pro-Tip: Any 'joining fee' or 'application fee' is illegal — refund immediately if collected.
